claims.explanation: ICI-162846 is an H2 histamine receptor antagonist, so selective killing likely reflects dependence of sensitive cancer lines on HRH2-mediated histamine signaling for survival/proliferation. Activating PI3K/AKT (PIK3CA mutation or PTEN loss) or MAPK (BRAF mutation) provides a protective bypass and is enriched in resistant lines, while KRAS/NF1 mutations and SF3B1 mutations mark sensitive subsets. The primary predictive biomarker is therefore HRH2 expression, with PI3K pathway alterations conferring resistance.
